# Flux job script translated from Slurm

#flux: -q phillips
#flux: --job-name=filt1
#flux: -t 00:240:00 # Note: This time format is unusual and may need to be '4:00:00'
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 4
#flux: --array=0-39

# The following Slurm directive for account was not translated as it is not a standard Flux option.
# It must be filled in by the user or is handled by site-specific policies.
# #SBATCH -A phillipslab


# Flux does not provide a standard equivalent to $SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK.
# The value is hardcoded to match the number of CPUs requested by the '-c' directive.
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4

module load easybuild  icc/2017.1.132-GCC-6.3.0-2.27  impi/2017.1.132 skewer

cd /projects/phillipslab/ateterina/CR_popgen/data/reads/
LISTFILES=(*.fastq)

# The Slurm array variable is replaced by the Flux equivalent, $FLUX_TASK_ID.
file=${LISTFILES[$FLUX_TASK_ID]}

#remove adapter + qc
# The '-t 4' argument to skewer correctly uses the 4 CPUs requested by the '-c 4' directive.
skewer -x AGATCGGAAGAG -t 4 -q 20 -l 36 -d 0.1 -r 0.1 -o ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1} $file ${file/_1.fastq/_2.fastq};


mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair1.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp1.ok.fastq}
mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair2.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp2.ok.fastq}

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH -A phillipslab
#SBATCH --partition=phillips       ### Partition
#SBATCH --job-name=filt1    ### Job Name
#SBATCH --time=00:240:00        ### WallTime
#SBATCH --nodes=1              ### Number of Nodes
#SBATCH --ntasks=1             ### Number of tasks per array job
#SBATCH --array=0-39           ### Array index
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4            ### Number of CPU cores per task
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK

module load easybuild  icc/2017.1.132-GCC-6.3.0-2.27  impi/2017.1.132 skewer

cd /projects/phillipslab/ateterina/CR_popgen/data/reads/
LISTFILES=(*.fastq)

file=${LISTFILES[$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID]}

#remove adapter + qc
skewer -x AGATCGGAAGAG -t 4 -q 20 -l 36 -d 0.1 -r 0.1 -o ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1} $file ${file/_1.fastq/_2.fastq};


mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair1.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp1.ok.fastq}
mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair2.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp2.ok.fastq}
